description: This file contains JavaScript code that initializes and manages terminal-like animations, dynamic announcements, and sponsor image handling on a webpage.

methods.name: setupTermynal
methods.description: Initializes terminal animations on elements with class 'use-termynal' and creates custom terminal instances.

methods.name: createTermynals
methods.description: Parses code blocks to generate terminal line data and creates Termynal instances.

methods.name: loadVisibleTermynals
methods.description: Initializes terminal animations for elements visible in the viewport.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomizes the order of elements in an array.

methods.name: showRandomAnnouncement
methods.description: Displays a rotating set of announcement elements within a specified group at a given interval.

methods.name: handleSponsorImages
methods.description: Ensures sponsor images are loaded before displaying the sponsor section and starts rotating sponsor images.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up terminal animations, announcements, and sponsor images handling.
